parameters.name: ScriptType
parameters.description:
The type of the script. Valid values:

*   BOOTSTRAP: indicates a bootstrap action of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.
*   NORMAL: indicates a common script.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr delete-script --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --script-type BOOTSTRAP --script-id cs-da7476a7679a4d4c9cede62ebe090000 --region cn-hangzhou
